claim: Development-only Stage 3 extended violation panel v2: four NEW violation categories (prohibited_action_present / required_condition_not_enforced / constraint_violated / exception_not_handled), 10 controlled variants each (40 total), generated from the frozen GDPR-7 BPMN membership without modifying it. The four methods (Winter-style extension / Sun-style extension / BM25 extension / TF-IDF-SVD extension) share the SAME new-type formulas and only swap each method's existing similarity backend. Winter et al. (2020) and Sun et al. (2024) define none of these four types: this panel is a project extension and must never be presented as native capability of the original papers. The panel is NOT human Gold and NOT the formal Oracle.

prohibited_action_present.definition: a regulation-prohibited action appears as a process activity
prohibited_action_present.decision: violation iff rule modality == prohibition AND score_prohibited >= gamma_ext
prohibited_action_present.candidate_surface: activity and event labels of the variant process model

required_condition_not_enforced.definition: a required condition is not visible in any gateway / conditionExpression / sequence-flow label / adjacent control node
required_condition_not_enforced.decision: violation iff rule condition non-empty AND action mappable (>= per-method gamma) AND score_condition > gamma_ext
required_condition_not_enforced.candidate_surface: sequence-flow labels, conditionExpression texts, gateway labels, adjacent control nodes of the mapped activity

constraint_violated.definition: a time / quantity / usage constraint is missing from the model or explicitly contradicted
constraint_violated.decision: violation iff rule constraint non-empty AND action mappable AND (score_constraint > gamma_ext OR exact time-limit contradiction recorded)
constraint_violated.candidate_surface: activity labels, data object/data store labels, text annotations, timer/event labels, flow labels, adjacent-node visible time/quantity/restriction text
constraint_violated.exact_contradiction: deterministic (value, unit) time-limit comparison; a candidate limit strictly greater than the rule limit is recorded as exact contradiction (never hard-coded 0/1)

exception_not_handled.definition: a regulation exception has no boundary event / error-escalation event / alternate branch / exception-handler activity
exception_not_handled.decision: violation iff rule exception non-empty AND action mappable AND score_exception > gamma_ext
exception_not_handled.candidate_surface: boundary events, error/escalation event definitions, alternate outgoing branches, exception-cued activity/event labels

thresholds.gamma_ext_rule: unified fixed decision threshold for all four new types, frozen in this config, NOT tuned on any panel or method output; missing-evidence scores use score > gamma_ext, prohibited presence uses score >= gamma_ext
thresholds.action_mapping_gamma: per-method frozen action-mapping threshold from each method's own development config: winter 0.4, sun 0.8, bm25 0.8, tfidf_svd 0.5 (used only for the action-mappable precondition of condition/constraint/exception)

winter.note: Winter et al. (2020) define no such violation types; this is a project extension reusing the Winter similarity backend and the frozen Winter gamma for action mapping

sun.backend: WinterSimilarity (spaCy en_core_web_sm), the shared dev backend of the Sun reconstruction
sun.note: Sun et al. (2024) define no such violation types (paper Definitions 4-7 cover action/actor/order only); this is a project extension reusing the Sun development scoring backend and the frozen Sun gamma for action mapping

bm25.note: candidate collection for the new types is the per-variant union of the process candidate texts (documented extension of the S3.6-A v3 backend); action mapping keeps the action-label corpus

tfidf_svd.note: same frozen fit corpus as the S3.6-B development run: unlabeled rule texts + source process labels only

panel.controls: development-only synthetic compliant controls derived from the frozen BPMN (byte-unchanged source recorded per variant); controls and variants are scored diagnostically, only variants are evaluated

observability_policy.unobservable: score=None and predicted=None; counts as FN in the primary macro/micro/exact denominators; never hard-filled with 0.0 or 1.0
